rows.transcript: A checkout button? First we need a bounded context diagram. I propose separate cart, pricing, checkout and checkout-orchestration services, communicating through a service bus. The actual screen belongs to the presentation team; I cannot worry about that until we approve my reference architecture. Look at these arrows. Beautiful.
